newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Stalprodukt sees issue price near PLN 30.
newsitem.headline: Polish Stalprodukt sees issue price near PLN 30.

text.p: Polish steel maker Stalprodukt SA expects the issue price of its initial public offering to be near 30 zlotys, the upper limit of an earlier announced range of 21 and 30 zlotys, the firm's president said.
Piotr Janeczek told a meeting of analysts and journalists on Tuesday that the final issue price of the 1.2-million-share April offering would be announced on March 27 after book building.
"I believe the issue price should be close to the maximum price of 30 zlotys," he said.
Janeczek said the company planned to have 800,000 of the shares underwritten but said it was too early to name the underwriters.
"We can't yet announce who will underwrite the issue but I can't rule out that Pekao SA will lead the underwriting consortium," he said, referring to a state-owned bank.
Janeczek said the company, which seeks a main market listing on the Warsaw bourse, should start trade there in June or early July.
